expected.compose_yaml:
services:
  "lma-hospital-e":
    image: "dagents/lma:1"
    expose:
      - "8010"
    ports:
      - "0.0.0.0:9100:9100"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:8010/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    networks:
      - "healthcare-demo_default"
    restart: unless-stopped
  "seed-hospital-e":
    image: "dagents/lma:1"
    command: ["seed"]
    depends_on:
      "lma-hospital-e":
        condition: service_healthy
      "lma-hospital-e-init":
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    networks:
      - "healthcare-demo_default"
    restart: "no"
  "lma-hospital-e-init":
    image: "dagents/lma:1"
    networks:
      - "healthcare-demo_default"
    restart: "no"
networks:
  "healthcare-demo_default":
    external: true
